## What this does

Cuts CI wall-clock waiting without weakening a required check.

- **D1 — four concurrent pytest processes.** `make test-par` runs
  `scripts/ci/pytest_partitions.py run` over the committed table
  `scripts/ci/pytest_partitions.txt` (`tests/ops tests/e2e` ·
  `docs/build/tools` · `tests/db` · `*`). The runner validates the table
  (overlap/nesting/missing/out-of-`testpaths`/0-or-2 `*` → exit 2),
  scrubs the child environment, keeps per-partition `--basetemp`, logs
  and rc files, replays `::group::` logs, and exits 0 only when every rc
  is 0 **and** every log carries a `passed` summary — rc 5, a missing rc
  file and rc 0 without the summary are red (SIG-ENG-042). The `python`
  job's Test step and `ci-local` run it; `make test` and `make check`
  stay serial. Local proof: partition verdicts identical to the serial
  baseline (same 15 environmental/pre-existing failures, none
  partition-introduced); longest leg ≈ 13 min vs serial ≈ 26 min.
- **D2 — fixture-mode Lighthouse reuse, same-PR only.** A records-only
  push cannot change the fixture-mode measurement, so the one
  `Performance budgets` step may reuse a prior same-PR pass when
  `scripts/ci/perf_reuse.py decide` proves: pull_request event,
  same-repo head, fresh fingerprint == `CI_FINGERPRINT`, a strict
  nine-key `sig.perf-pass/1` record at `$CI_RECORD` whose `nonrecords`
  and `pr` match, no symlink/gitlink in HEAD's tree, the coupling lint
  clean over the audited `perf_reuse_allow.txt`, and the same
  `ImageOS-ImageVersion`. Everything else — push, dispatch, forks,
  errors — answers `run`. The record is written only at the end of a
  green same-repo PR job that measured, under a per-run cache key
  (`perf-pass-v1-<fp>-<run>-<attempt>`; restored via the `-none`
  impossible key + `…-` prefix), and the reuse is a `ci-perf-reuse`
  notice naming the prior run/head — never a fresh measurement. All
  other steps, including the export-mode leg, run on every head.
- **D3 — records.** ADR-219 + index, Appendix F row + spec rebuild,
  ADR_TRIGGERS.csv, BACKLOG sources + regen, AGENTS.md/tests/AGENTS.md
  lines, Makefile header correction, ci.yml step-gating comment.
- **D1 arc (OM-18):** two partitioned runs failed on
  `test_memory_is_bounded_by_one_capture` — the wiring was reverted per
  the contract's stop rule, then **re-armed** after the flake proved
  environmental (the untouched base head `1aedaecf` failed the same
  test serially on the same runner image: run 39520363036 attempt 1
  green, attempts 2–3 red, attempt 4 green — intermittent). The test
  was repaired inside this ticket (operator-authorised widening): it
  now measures CURRENT traced bytes at a pinned point (post-run, after
  `gc.collect()`) — what the run retains — instead of the
  timing-sensitive peak; a warm-up run absorbs first-touch costs. The
  assertion is unchanged (`bounded < unbounded/5`); local: 492 B/page
  vs 8765 B/page, byte-identical across 4 runs.
